info.title: ubticareers Finance Demo
info.description: USMF customer demo: existing customer CRUD and limited recent history, plus separate complete-data posted receivables, invoice remaining amounts, overdue reports . Writes only to TEST-COPILOT- accounts with confirmation. No posting or settlement.

FinanceDemoKey.name: X-Finance-Demo-Key
FinanceDemoKey.description: Paste the privately derived connector key into the connection credential. Never supply the D365 client secret or make this an AI-filled tool parameter.

get.description: Read a bounded set of USMF customers. Returned records are limited; no arbitrary filter or company input is accepted.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records returned (1–20). Results are limited, not a full history or balance.

504.description: Upstream request timed out; a write may have an uncertain outcome

default.description: Request failed; inspect the typed error before deciding next steps

get.description: Read a bounded list of transactions for an exact USMF customer account. Amounts are decimal strings. The response is limited history, not a complete balance. Transaction capability can be unavailable independently of customer operations.

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Exact customer account in fixed legal entity USMF. Writes require the TEST-COPILOT- prefix.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of records returned (1–20). Results are limited, not a full history or balance.

get.description: Read-only D365 operation. Complete scans prepare in the background: report_preparing is retryable; repeat the same request after five seconds. Never infer final totals from partial scans or recent-history records. Inspect completeness, currency, unknown classification counts and fetch window. Read complete current customer balance

parameters.name: account
parameters.description: Exact USMF customer account, for example AST-001.

parameters.name: currency
parameters.description: Optional transaction currency. Omit to keep all currencies as separate totals.
